title: Implement roman.py with to_roman/from_roman and tests

checks.command:
python - <<'PY'
from roman import to_roman, from_roman
assert to_roman(4)=='IV' and to_roman(9)=='IX' and to_roman(1994)=='MCMXCIV'
assert from_roman('MCMXCIV')==1994
assert all(from_roman(to_roman(n))==n for n in range(1,4000))
for bad in (0, 4000, -1, 3.5, 'x', '', 'IIII'):
    try:
        to_roman(bad)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise SystemExit('missing ValueError for %r' % (bad,))
print('roman OK')
PY
